title: onboarding-plan
description: Step 2 of `team onboard`: brief + the owner's answers → VISION.md, GAME-DESIGN.md v1, product.yaml fields and the first backlog. The dispatcher writes the files and creates the tasks; the owner reads owner_summary_md.

vision_md.description: the full VISION.md, following the template given in the prompt; every placeholder filled, nothing invented about accounts the owner did not grant

game_design_md.description: GAME-DESIGN.md v1: core loop, rules, win/lose, players, session length, progression, what makes a round interesting, anti-patterns, balance tables as data with 'what to change if…'. Empty when the first backlog task asks the game-designer role to write it.

stage.description: the current milestone id, e.g. M0

host.description: empty or 'pending' until the owner hands the host over

phase_gates.description: cycle phase or check → the milestone from which it runs, e.g. {"marketing": "M2", "seo": "M1", "persona": "M1", "geo": "M2", "voice": "M2"}

depends_on.description: titles of earlier tasks in this list

state.description: deferred = needs an account the owner did not grant; return_condition says what brings it back

decisions.description: one line per default applied or choice made, for decisions.md

owner_summary_md.description: Russian, ≤ 200 words: what the team will build first, what waits for which account, what it will cost per day
